name: Tebra

lifecycle.notes: Formed in November 2021 from merger of Kareo and PatientPop

short_description: All-in-one platform combining EHR, billing, practice management, and patient engagement for independent healthcare practices.
long_description: Tebra is a comprehensive healthcare technology platform formed in November 2021 through the merger of Kareo (electronic healthcare records and medical billing) and PatientPop (practice growth and patient engagement). The name 'Tebra' is derived from 'vertebrae,' symbolizing the company's role as the backbone of practice success. Headquartered with offices in Santa Monica, California and Irvine, California, Tebra serves over 140,000 healthcare providers covering more than 120 million patients in the United States. The platform offers an integrated suite including clinical EHR, practice management, medical billing, revenue cycle management, telehealth, patient engagement, reputation management, and digital marketing tools. Tebra achieved unicorn status with a $1+ billion valuation in 2022. The platform is designed for independent practices across specialties including behavioral health, though it's not mental health-specific.
one_liner: The complete platform for independent practices combining EHR, billing, and patient growth.
best_for: Independent medical practices wanting comprehensive platform
Multi-specialty groups needing EHR, billing, and marketing together
Practices seeking patient acquisition and engagement tools
Providers looking for full RCM services option
not_for: Practices seeking specialized mental health EHR features
Organizations wanting simple, focused EHR solution

pricing.notes: Custom pricing: approximately $149-$499/provider/month. Two main bundles: Practice Essentials (billing, clinical EHR, telehealth) and Practice Automation (adds patient engagement tools). Kareo Clinical: $80-$225+/provider/month. Full combined suite: $300-$799/provider/month. RCM services: 4-9% of collections. PDMP integration: $500 one-time + ~$50/user/year.

faqs.a: Tebra uses custom pricing ranging from $49-$799/provider/month depending on modules. Practice Essentials (EHR, billing, telehealth) runs approximately $149-$499/provider/month. RCM services are 4-9% of collections. Contact for personalized quote.
Kareo merged with PatientPop in November 2021 to form Tebra. The combined platform offers unified EHR, billing, and patient engagement. Existing Kareo customers transitioned to the Tebra platform.

faqs.q: Is Tebra good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Tebra serves behavioral health practices but is not mental health-specific. It's a multi-specialty platform. Practices wanting mental health-focused features may prefer SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, or Valant.
Yes, Tebra offers full Revenue Cycle Management services at 4-9% of collections. This includes claim scrubbing, denial management, and AR follow-up along with access to the software suite.
